## RISK SCORING MATRIX

### Probability Scale
| Score | Probability | Description |
|-------|-------------|-------------|
| 5 | Almost Certain | >80% likelihood of occurring |
| 4 | Likely | 61-80% likelihood of occurring |
| 3 | Possible | 41-60% likelihood of occurring |
| 2 | Unlikely | 21-40% likelihood of occurring |
| 1 | Rare | ≤20% likelihood of occurring |

### Impact Scale
| Score | Impact | Description |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| 5 | Critical | Catastrophic impact on objectives; organization-threatening |
| 4 | Major | Significant impact on objectives; severe operational disruption |
| 3 | Moderate | Noticeable impact on objectives; some operational disruption |
| 2 | Minor | Limited impact on objectives; minimal operational disruption |
| 1 | Negligible | Insignificant impact on objectives; no operational disruption |

### Risk Level Calculation
**Risk Score = Probability × Impact**

| Risk Score | Risk Level | Action Required |
|------------|------------|-----------------|
| 15-25 | Extreme | Immediate action required; executive attention |
| 10-14 | High | Action plan required; management attention |
| 6-9 | Medium | Monitor and manage; routine attention |
| 1-5 | Low | Monitor; no immediate action required |

## RISK INTERDEPENDENCIES

### Correlated Risks
[Risks that are correlated — if one occurs, others are more likely to occur.]

| Risk A | Risk B | Correlation Type | Description |
|--------|--------|------------------|-------------|
| R001 | R005 | Positive | If R001 occurs, R005 probability increases to [Level] |
| R003 | R007 | Positive | If R003 occurs, R007 probability increases to [Level] |

### Cascading Risks
[Risks that trigger other risks — chain reactions.]

| Trigger Risk | Secondary Risk | Scenario |
|--------------|----------------|----------|
| R001 | R004 → R009 | If R001 occurs, it triggers R004, which then triggers R009 |
| R002 | R006 → R008 | If R002 occurs, it triggers R006, which then triggers R008 |

### Mitigation Interdependencies

## ESCALATION PROTOCOLS

### Escalation Triggers
[What conditions trigger risk escalation?]

| Trigger Condition | Escalation Level | Escalate To | Response Time |
|-------------------|-----------------|------------|---------------|
| Risk score increases to Extreme | Level 1 | Executive Sponsor | Immediate |
